title: John Meadows PPLUL - Avalanche & Warlock
author: Barry E.
desc: Push Pull Legs, Upper Lower workout combining John Meadows Avalanche and Warlock programs.

ex.note:
Do 2-3 light sets of 10-15 here to warm up. After this start increasing weight.
First set of 8 should be a hard set. Next set do same weight and then drop weight 25% and go to failure
Standing cable row - use an incline bench as support.

Once you get to a weight that you can do for say 5 to 6 reps, I want you to do 10 rest-pause singles with it. So, do a rep, and set the weight down, take a breath and hit it again. Engage lats on each
I want you to just let the weight stretch you at the top for 15 seconds after your last rep. Do 1 feeder set of 6 reps just to get the rhythm.
Only rest 30 seconds in between each set
Do 1 warm up set, then 3 sets of 25. This will burn like fire. I only use 25 lb. dumbbells when I do these.

Do a few warm ups, then low rep feeder sets. Do about 8 reps there. We’ll then do a 2nd all out set there where you try to match the number, and then drop the
weight 30% and go to failure again.
I want a brutal set of 12, and then a brutal set of 8. Please keep form perfect on these sets. Stop just short of failure and only with good form.

Find a weight that is a tough 8 with a full range of motion including lock out.
Go to failure, pause 20 secs, go to failure again, pause, failure again
2 sets to failure - hands on 25kg plate to increase range of motion
Raise the dumbbells to 10 and 2 o’clock and feel the burn! Do 3 sets of 12 here.

I want you to do 8 hard reps. On your second set I want you to do 8, drop the weight 20-30% and do another 8 or so, followed by 10 slow partials from the stretch position, followed by a 20 sec isohold

I want you to find a weight that is extremely hard to complete 10 reps with using a full range of motion.  5 secs rest in between the last 25 reps as prescribed

20 lbs. x 5
30 lbs. x 5
40 lbs. x 5

Use safety bar for Good mornings, 3 sets of 10 nice and slow
You are going to do 2 sets of 10. After you do 10 reps, do 10 more partials, and then sit in the stretch for 10 more seconds. Tib raises x20 between

We want to stop 2-3 inches short of our chest, then blast up to 3/4’s lockout. Our goal is to do a few warm up sets of 10, then 2 feeder sets of 4 then we will do 3 working sets of 8 before we move on
On your first work set give 10 reps where you literally fail at 10. Rest 3 mins and then use the same load, go to failure, then drop by 30% and failure once more.
Focus on getting a really good stretch on your pecs with every rep.
I want 2 warm-up sets of 10 so that you get into the groove of back training, then 2 feeder sets to get to your working weight.
I want to use a slightly wider than shoulder width, pronated grip and aim to get 4 sets of 10 reps.

I want 3 hard sets of 8 once you get to your working weight.
